uncertain.why: ontology lists ISX under HD_K50 but all its motifs (JASPAR MA0654.2, HOCOMOCO ISX.0-2, CIS-BP) read TAATTA/TTAATTAG, i.e. Q50-like — consider HD_Q50.
TFClass puts NANOG in the NK-related homeodomain family, but its motif (TAATGG/CCATTA; one HOCOMOCO model is the POU5F1 octamer composite) is not the NKX TAAGTG site.
listed in both MYC_MAX and TBX defs; JASPAR MA0801.1 and CIS-BP M02821 consensus is AGGTGTGA, a T-box half-site, so TBX.
bare token comes from Vierstra AC0029:NKX/MSANTD whose motif is CACTCA (NKX-like); kept with MSANTD1/3/4 per ontology but HD_NKX would match the motif.
explicitly listed in ZNF_SCAN_OTHER, yet its motif (CACTCA, JASPAR MA1523.2 / CIS-BP M01259) clusters with NKX homeodomain motifs.
bare token covers two Vierstra archetypes: AC0316 (GCCGTGTGCAAA = MTF1 MRE) and AC0267 (CCCGACG = matches the MTF2 motif); assigned to the MTF1 MRE family.
named in both MBD_CXXC and CHROMATIN defs; CxxC domain binds unmethylated CpG and the motifs are CpG/GC-rich, so grouped with the CxxC readers.
same dual listing as KMT2A; motif GCGGCGGC is CpG-rich, grouped with CxxC readers rather than CHROMATIN.
chromatin demethylase but explicitly listed in MBD_CXXC; motif ATTACGCGC is CpG-centred.
as KDM2A; CIS-BP motif tatttaCGc is a CpG-containing CxxC site.
listed in both MYB (as a Myb/SANT archetype) and ZNF_SCAN_OTHER; kept in MYB on DBD grounds although its motif (GCGCAAAT) is not an MBS.
BTB/POZ+BEN protein with no C2H2 finger; placed with BANP (same architecture, same ontology entry) rather than ZBTB_OTHER.
myoneurin is a BTB-ZF so ZBTB_OTHER by domain, but its motif (GACTTTTATTTT) is AT-rich and unlike other BTB-ZF sites.
C2H2 factor with no dedicated entry and no KRAB domain; its G-rich HOCOMOCO motif (aatGGGGATttg) is close to the MAZ G-rich family.
PRC2 accessory Polycomb-like reader; GC-rich motif CCCGACG comes from its winged-helix CpG contact, not a classical DBD.
GC-binding factor 2 / dsRNA binder with no classical DBD; single HOCOMOCO model LRRF1.H14CORE.0 (aaGCTCGCcg).
Mohawk is a TALE-class homeodomain (formerly IRXL1); HOCOMOCO motif acaTGTAa matches the IRX archetype consensus ACATGT rather than PBX/MEIS TGACAG.
assigned to HNF4 per the ontology (NR2C1/2 included there); the bare token comes from Vierstra AC0114:NR4A/NR2C, a monomeric half-site cluster.
Mblk1/Psq-type HTH corepressor; no matching ontology family (see proposal LCOR_MBLK1).
same Psq/Mblk1 HTH as LCOR; Vierstra clusters its motif with forkhead (AC0014:FOXR/LCORL) but it is not a forkhead protein.

proposals.name: LCOR / LCORL (Mblk1/Psq HTH)
proposals.def: Mblk1-related corepressors with a pipsqueak (Psq) helix-turn-helix DNA-binding domain; AT-rich CCAAAATT-like motifs, largely inferred. LCOR, LCORL.
proposals.why: LCOR/LCORL share a distinct Psq/Mblk1 HTH domain that fits neither MYB (no MBS motif) nor the Forkhead cluster Vierstra assigned their archetype to.
